audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Keep the unbound rank and wrong projection result; infer strong normalization from a proof of one normalizing strategy; treat the common reduct N-triple-prime itself as already normal; silently invent a full local-confluence proof.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The disjunction constructor is typed A1-or-A2, so its length is len(A1)+len(A2)+1. Substitution for x can create a case-elimination redex only when the case scrutinee is x and N is an injection. A variable is not a redex and has no cutrank. First projection selects O1; both contraction orders join at O1-prime when the inner reduction is in O1. Existence of one terminating path does not imply all paths terminate. For Newman's descent, choose a normal form of the common reduct before comparison.
